shortDescription: Take an on-demand file back-up on IBM Storage protect.

options.name: absolute
options.description: Use the absolute variable with the incremental command to force a backup of all files and directories that match the file specification or domain, even if the objects were not changed since the last incremental backup.Setting to a value of "Yes" will enable the mentioned functionality.

options.name: backup_action
options.description: Type of backup to perform (selective or incremental).

options.name: diff_snapshot
options.description: The diff_snapshot variable controls whether the backup-archive client creates the differential snapshot when it runs a snapshot difference incremental backup. Use with incremental command.If value is set to "create"  backup-archive client will create the snapshot during incremental backup. If the value it set to "latest" client will use the latest snapshot that is found on the file server as source snapshot.

options.name: dirs_only
options.description: The dirs_only variable when set to "Yes" processes directories only during backup. The client does not process files. Use with incremental and selective command.

options.name: file_list
options.description: Use the file_list variable to process a list of files. The backup-archive client opens the file you specify with this variable and processes the list of files within according to the specific command.Use with incremental and selective command.

options.name: files_only
options.description: The files_only variable when set to "Yes" restricts backup processing to files only. Use with incremental and selective comand.

options.name: filespec
options.description: The paths of the files or directories to backup.Supports list of multiple files and directories, separated by a space character;in addition, use wildcard characters to include a group of files or to include all files in a directory.

options.name: is_compress_always
options.description: Use this variable together with is_compression_enabled. When is_compression_enabled is set to " Yes", the is_compress_always variable specifies whether to continue compressing an object if it grows during compression.Setting to a velue of "Yes" will continue to compress an object even if size of object grows after compression. Setting to a value of "No" will send the file uncompressed if the file size increases.Use with the incremental , and selective commands

options.name: is_compression_enabled
options.description: The compression variable compresses files before you send them to the server.Use with the incremental,and selective commands.Setting to a value of "Yes" will enable the compression. A value of "No" will ensure files are not compressed.

options.name: is_subdir
options.description: The subdir variable specifies whether you want to include subdirectories of named directories for processing.If set to Yes subdirectories are processed otherwise no.Use with incremental and selective commands.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_PASSWORD)

options.name: remove_operand_limit
options.description: The remove_operand_limit variable  specifies that the client removes the 20-operand limit as this limits the number of files and directories that can be specified with command.Use with incremental and selective commands.Setting the value to "Yes" will remove the limit.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the IBM Storage Protect host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: server_name
options.description: SERVERNAME your IBM Storage Protect instance as specified in the dsm.sys. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_SERVERNAME) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(local) will be used

options.name: snapshot_root
options.description: Use the snapshot_root variable with the incremental, selective, commands to specify the root directory of snapshot that should be used for backup. This option is used in snapshot-supported environments. With this mechanism backup only processes snapshot data and not live filesystem. Example - dsmc incremental /mnt/snapshot1/data -snapshotroot=/mnt/snapshot1

options.name: username
options.description: Username for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_USERNAME)
